versions.content: If CanIf receives a L-PDU (see CanIf_RxIndication() ), it shall perform the following comparisons to select the correct reception L-SDU configured in CanIfRxPduCfg : • compare CanIfRxPduCanId with the passed Mailbox->CanId ( Can_Id- Type ) excluding the two most significant bits • compare CanIfRxPduCanIdType with the two most significant bits of the passed Mailbox->CanId ( Can_IdType )
